notes: Revised Edition base game only. Seasonal/folklore editions, Patchwork Express and Automa are excluded.

The SVG redraws the board as an original text-free schematic; it does not copy publisher artwork. Time spaces and market seats are fixed positions, while patch shapes/order and player placements are recorded as state.

The 53 spaces use an original schematic spiral, not the publisher's printed geometry. Event markers are re-traced from the official base-board illustration; the first leather-patch event is known to move on newer prints, so these IDs are visual reference positions and must be checked against a photographed copy before claiming edition-exact placement.

Each market patch instance must preserve its exact orthogonally-connected cell mask, printed button cost, time cost and income-icon flag. Quilt occupancy is a per-instance cell mask, not a stack of unrelated occupied cells.
The 5 special patches are one-cell pieces. The 7x7 bonus tile is a separate one-per-game entitlement; keep its owner nullable until actually awarded.
Button supply artwork is symbolic; exact reserve and per-player amounts belong in denomination/count state. Button counts are not capped by the static SVG.

structureEvidence.location: Setup, Playing the Game, Components, The Time Board; direct board diagram
structureEvidence.method: official publisher rulebook downloaded and directly inspected
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: 2 players; 9x9 quilt boards; regular patch ring around the time board; 33 regular patches; 5 single-cell special patches on marked time spaces; 53-step time board; two time tokens and one neutral market token; one 7x7 bonus tile worth 7; 50 button tiles in denominations 32x1, 12x5, 5x10, 1x20. The official diagram shows the spiral board, event marks and the circular market.

2025 Revised Edition updates colors and artwork while gameplay and rules remain the same; its component count is 3 boards and 89 cardboard tiles, consistent with the original base rulebook component breakdown.

structureEvidence.location: Setup, Components, The Time Board; official Revised Edition rulebook, pp. 1-2
structureEvidence.method: official publisher PDF text and diagrams directly inspected
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: The current Revised Edition confirms the circular 33-patch market, two 9x9 quilt boards, the time-board event spaces, two time tokens, one neutral token, five special patches, one 7x7 bonus tile and 50 buttons in denominations 32x1, 12x5, 5x10 and 1x20.
The publisher documents that the first leather special patch was moved on newer prints; older copies may differ, and the correction is edition-dependent.

market.initialNeutralRule: place between the smallest 1x2 regular patch and the next patch clockwise

timeBoard.spaceEventLocations: visual transcription from official base-board illustration; geometry is an original simplified schematic

quiltPlacement.patchGeometry: store one shapeCells mask per patch instance; position by originRow/originColumn; preserve orientation and list of occupied board cells
quiltPlacement.orientationModel: quarter-turn rotation; do not infer mirror-flip support from the asset

specialPatches.trigger: time token moves onto or past a marked time-board space
specialPatches.placement: immediately place on an empty quilt cell or explicitly record removed from play

bonusTile.award: first player to fully fill a 7x7 square

buttonSupply.supplyState: remaining physical tokens can be represented by denomination/count pairs

turnAndResumeState.activePlayer: time token furthest behind; if tied, upper stacked token
turnAndResumeState.pendingBoundary: record completed action steps and next unresolved step; no automatic rules resolution required
